svg.title: Issue 8 — Page 1 — Panel 1: Wall-cavity camp briefing — Luma presents holographic city map, squad watching, the cool blue-violet data dominant against warm gaslight
svg.desc: 28mm wide establishing slight high angle. Squad camp wall-cavity. Five squad members exactly. Luma center on crossbeam, holographic city map projected — rotating 3D map with pulsing blue-violet location markers. Sable arms folded narrowed eyes. Wren leaning against nail-bollard arms crossed eyes flicking to Sable. Jink crouching higher beam chin on fist. Thresh weapon across knees scanning entry gap. Mid-briefing. Heavy wear suits but holographic nodes still pulse.
svg.text: I've been mapping these for three weeks. The pattern is not random.
